title: Positive Eigenvalues of Hadamard Square Roots on Finite Abelian Groups
summary: For a finite abelian group $G$, let $μ_2(G)$ be the minimum number of positive eigenvalues of an entrywise positive real symmetric group-circulant matrix whose entrywise square is positive definite. We prove that $μ_2(G)\le5$ precisely when $|G|\le15$, and that $μ_2(G)=6$ precisely when $|G|=16$ or $G$ is cyclic of order $18$, $20$ or $22$. For the noncyclic groups of order at most fifteen, the minimum is three for $C_2^2$ and five otherwise.
